narr: A cluster of showers and storms pushed into south-central Pennsylvania from the southwest during the evening of July 15, 2023. Additional showers and storms developed farther to the northeast from the middle Susquehanna Valley northeastward into the Endless Mountains region. Sporadic wind damage was observed with both areas of storms, and the northeastern area of storms began training which led to flash flooding in portions of Lycoming County.
ev: Heavy rain from training thunderstorms led to flash flooding near Pennsdale, with a vehicle becoming stuck in water of unknown depth on Pond Road.
Heavy rain from training thunderstorms caused flash flooding in Washington Township, with a stretch of Route 44 near Elimsport becoming covered with water.
